articles.title: GitHub Releases · Vercel CLI: vercel@54.20.0
articles.summary: ### Minor Changes - b9e4f06: Add a `vercel agent-runs` command for Agent Runs observability: `list` lists Agent Runs for a project, `inspect ` shows run metadata, events, usage, and subagents, `trace ` shows the full trace (turns, messages, reasoning, and tool calls), and `projects` lists projects in the team with Agent Runs activity. All subcommands support `--json` for machine-readable output.
